'''Blossom wine''' was a rare, fragrant [[Wine/Legends|wine]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by distilling natural essences of different [[Flower/Legends|flower]] blossoms.

==History==
In [[3653 BBY]], during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Adraas]] and [[Darth Angral]] drank some blossom [[Wine/Legends|wine]] in the office of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Berooken]], whom Angral had brutally [[Death/Legends|murdered]]. The two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] thought that it was an excellent vintage, but "right at the end of its cellar life."<ref name="Deceived" />

During the reigns of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Kings]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] and [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], blossom wine was often served.<ref name="SWDP" /> At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade of Naboo]], the wine was manufactured at the [[Summit Farm Blossom Winery]], a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] situated in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="End Game" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], on [[Void Station]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] named [[Jib Kopatha]] offered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] some "delicacies" in order to calm down the Sith Lord's anger. One of them was a brunette [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Unidentified Naboo female|woman]] with a bottle of blossom wine, who painfully reminded Vader of his late wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="SWETV" />
